name: discord-ticket-bot
description: Self-hosted Discord ticketing bot template (discord.js v14) with MySQL storage and public website

scripts.test: DISCORD_TOKEN=test CLIENT_ID=test CLIENT_SECRET=test MYSQL_HOST=127.0.0.1 MYSQL_USER=test MYSQL_PASSWORD=test MYSQL_DATABASE=test OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI=http://localhost:3000/auth/callback DB_FILE=data/test.db node --experimental-sqlite --test src/commands/*.test.js src/tickets/*.test.js src/loader.test.js src/statusHealth.test.js src/cluster.test.js
